Hi Leah — great to hear you're ready. Quick checklist so we can create the vendor master and map PO routing: 

- Legal entity full name (exact as on W-9)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form with EIN (PDF)
- Remit address for invoice payments (street, city, state, zip)
- AP contact name, email, and phone (for PO reconciliation)
- Preferred invoice submission method (email to AP or supplier portal)
- Banking/payment preference (ACH or wire) — optional if you require faster setup

I'll attach our supplier intake form to make this easy. If Sparrowlane has multiple legal entities, include a row per entity in the spreadsheet. Once we receive the W-9 and completed intake form, Marissa will provision the vendor record and Ben will validate PO routing to your AP inbox.
